ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No.11-L in the area bounded by

A line 125 feet southeast of West Agatite Avenue as

measured along the westerly right-of-way of North Milwaukee

Avenue and perpendicular thereto; North Milwaukee Avenue; a line

150 feet southeast of West Agatite Avenue as measured along

the westerly right-of-way line of North Milwaukee Avenue and

perpendicular thereto; and the public alley next west of and parallel to
North Milwaukee Avenue

to those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common address of property: 4416 North Milwaukee Avenue
